name: JJFO Daily News Scraper

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '30 2 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  scrape:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install requests beautifulsoup4 feedparser resend
      
      - name: Run scraper
        env:
          RESEND_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.RESEND_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          echo "RESEND_API_KEY=$RESEND_API_KEY" > .env
          python scraper.py
